name: Unpaid
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Settlement of Debts
Traits.text: At the start of each of the unpaid's turns, each creature that damaged the unpaid since its last turn takes 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage, and the unpaid regains Hit Points equal to the total damage dealt this way.
Traits.clause: Every wound the unpaid suffers is entered in its ledger as owed, and the ledger pulls: at the start of each of its turns
Traits.expresses: takes something every time it is wounded
Traits.expressedQuote: each creature that damaged the unpaid since its last turn takes 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage

Traits.name: Regeneration
Traits.text: The unpaid regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the unpaid takes Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function on the unpaid's next turn. The unpaid dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The unpaid makes three Claw attacks.

Actions.name: Claw
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

lore: Stitched from the unpaid dead and the ledgers that buried them, the Unpaid walks the roads of the living collecting what is owed to the grave, one wound and one payment at a time.
